name: IBANforge
description: Pre-payout screening for AI agents — vet a counterparty IBAN before you send funds: IBAN validation, BIC/SWIFT lookup, Swiss BC-Nummer clearing, sanctions screening (OFAC/EU/UN) + SEPA/VoP reachability and risk scoring. 121,399 BIC entries (38,761 LEI-enriched via GLEIF; additional rows from SWIFT directory, Bundesbank, SIX, NBP, EBA Step2 SCT), 1,190 Swiss clearing entries from SIX BankMaster, 89 countries. MCP-native + x402 micropayments on Base L2, free tier.

tools.name: validate_iban
tools.description: Validate a single IBAN with BIC, SEPA, issuer, and risk data ($0.005)

tools.name: batch_validate_iban
tools.description: Validate up to 100 IBANs in one call ($0.002 each)

tools.name: lookup_bic
tools.description: Look up a BIC/SWIFT code against 121,399 BIC entries (38,761 LEI-enriched via GLEIF) ($0.003)

tools.name: check_compliance
tools.description: Pre-payout screening: sanctions (OFAC/EU/UN) + FATF + SEPA reachability + VoP + risk score — vet a counterparty before you send funds ($0.02)

tools.name: lookup_ch_clearing
tools.description: Look up a Swiss BC-Nummer / IID with SIC, QR-IID, institution type — 1,190 entries from SIX BankMaster ($0.003)
